title: Retired Green Beret Organised Secret UFO Meetings to Warn Pastors About 'Very, Very Creepy' Beings
description: Former Green Beret Paul Bock says he helped organise a private Tennessee meeting to warn Christian pastors about an alleged UFO-linked belief system, though his claims remain unverified

title: Junkman's Daughter's UFO Awning Comes Down for Wild New L5P Mural
description: Junkman's Daughter in Atlanta's Little Five Points is replacing its aging UFO entrance with a new mural by folk artist Kyle Brooks.
